name: Search & Web
description: Tools to search the web and social media platforms and read web pages.
progressive_guidance: Prefer hosted.searchWeb for ordinary web searches when it is available for the active model. It reuses the selected profile connection. Use keenable.searchWeb when hosted search is unavailable or returns no usable evidence. Use Grok for X/social searches, deep research, or when explicitly requested. For reading a known public URL, prefer crawlberg.fetchUrl for locally extracted source text and remote documents. Try keenable.fetchUrl when local extraction fails and an indexed public copy would answer the question. Use browser_use for current JavaScript-dependent pages, login flows or browser challenges. hosted.fetchUrl is an optional fallback with supported active providers; it may return a summary. Do not route fetches to Grok unless explicitly requested.
